title: Brick Miniature — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Empty grid to piers
scenes.purpose: Establish the empty green stud grid at a tabletop macro angle, then drop three 2x2 piers onto stud columns; the yellow idea brick seats last on the left pier.

beats.development: Empty stud pattern visible; camera begins a slow push-in; title card starts fading up.
White pier bricks drop vertically course by course onto three 2x2 footprints at x = -10, 0, 10.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Yellow idea brick falls onto the left pier and seats with a squash.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Bridge snaps on
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the characteristic action in three stages: incoming along the X axis, alignment over an outlined footprint, seat onto the studs.
visuals: two 2x10 upper bricks straddling the lower seams

beats.development: Lower deck bricks slide in from the right along X at hover height; footprint outlines appear on the pier tops (alignment).
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Lower deck bricks seat straight down onto the piers, staggered, each with a small squash.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Upper course slides in, aligns over outlines spanning the lower seams, and seats to interlock the bridge; the pill label appears in the card.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Hold the completed connected bridge with the card fully legible.
visuals: completed bridge on the stud grid

beats.development: Everything settled; reading hold for title and pill.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Piers build quickly so the main bridge action has room for its three readable stages.
All motion settles by 2.6 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0 s final hold so the title and pill can be read on the settled bridge.

notes: No reviewed preview recipes are listed in STYLE.json; the preview demonstrates the style's characteristic action (empty stud grid, approach along one axis, snap an interlocking bridge).
